tok 1.0 "Meter registration"

pool org "Meter operation"
  lane mpon "MPON"
    start begin "Meter operation to report"
    task report "Report the meter operation to the GO"
    task equip "Perform the equipment acquisition and / or equipment changes"
    xor outcome "Outcome?"
    task fail "Inform the GO about the failure of the entire process"
    task success "Inform the GO about the successful completion of the entire process"
  lane go "GO"
    task examine "Examine the application of the MPON"
    xor ok "Application acceptable?"
    task reject "Reject the application of the MPON"
    task confirm "Confirm the application of the MPON"
    and reg "Registration confirmed"
    task regmpoo "Inform the MPOO about the registration confirmation"
    task regmspo "Inform the MSPO about the registration confirmation"
    and regd
    task late "Inform the MPON about the failure of the overall transaction by deadline"
    task cfail "Confirm the failure of the assignment to the MPON"
    and ffork
    task fmpoo "Inform the MPOO about the failure of the assignment"
    task fmspo "Inform the MSPO about the failure of the assignment"
    and fjoin
    task assign "Assign the MPON"
    task cassign "Confirm the assignment to the MPON"
    and sfork
    task smpoo "Inform the MPOO about the assignment of the MPON"
    task smspo "Inform the MSPO about the assignment of the MPON"
    task ssp "Inform the SP about the assignment of the MPON"
    and sjoin
    end rejected "Application rejected"
    end timedout "Transaction failed by deadline"
    end failed "Assignment failed"
    end assigned "MPON assigned"

flow begin -> report -> examine -> ok
flow ok -> reject "no"
flow ok -> confirm "yes"
flow reject -> rejected
flow confirm -> reg
flow reg -> regmpoo -> regd
flow reg -> regmspo -> regd
flow regd -> equip -> outcome
flow outcome -> fail "failure"
flow outcome -> success "success"
flow outcome -> late "no message by deadline"
flow late -> timedout
flow fail -> cfail -> ffork
flow ffork -> fmpoo -> fjoin
flow ffork -> fmspo -> fjoin
flow fjoin -> failed
flow success -> assign -> cassign -> sfork
flow sfork -> smpoo -> sjoin
flow sfork -> smspo -> sjoin
flow sfork -> ssp -> sjoin
flow sjoin -> assigned
